question: Kalamandalam Rajan received the Sangeet Natak Akademi Award 2009 for which of the following dance forms?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kathakali**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Kalamandalam Rajan** is a Kathakali exponent from Kerala, India. 
 
• He has been honored with several noted awards including the **Sangeet Natak Akademi Award 2009.**
 
• He has been also honored with** the Kerala Sangeetha Nataka Akademi Gurupooja **award** **2006 and awards from **Kerala Kalamandalam**.
 
• In **Kathakali,** Kalamandalam Rajan was expert in pacha, kathi and minukku roles.
 
• His performances as **Bahuka, Nala, and Dharmaputra **have been critically acclaimed.
 
• He had performed on many stages in India and abroad with Margi Kathakali Vidyalayam, Thiruvananthapuram, and was part of the Kathakali Festival conducted by **Sangeet Natak Akademi** in New Delhi in **1993**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Bharatanatyam** is a major form of Indian classical dance that originated in Tamil Nadu. 
 
• **Kathak** is one of the eight major forms of Indian classical dance. It is the classical dance form of Uttar Pradesh.
 
• **Odissi** also referred to as Orissa in old literature, is a major ancient Indian classical dance that originated in the Hindu temples of Odisha – an eastern coastal state of India.
